# Famyle (United States)

> Famyle is an online platform where families find and hire housekeepers, house cleaners, nannies, babysitters, pet sitters and cooks directly. Operating in Brazil for over 10 years; now accepting families and professionals in Orlando, Florida. Families post jobs for free; professionals join for free. Famyle is not an employer or staffing agency.

## Key facts
- City: Orlando, FL and nearby (Kissimmee, Clermont, Winter Garden). Families pay nothing until there are professionals for them.
- Free for families and professionals: no subscription, no fees.
- Professionals: free to join; we talk to every professional before introducing them to a family.
- Languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish. Guides in Portuguese for Brazilian families: https://us.famyle.com/pt/guias/
